L8·N8206unmasked layer
Fires on evaluative/appraisal adjectives and noun-modifiers that hype or rate something ("anticipated", "-worthy", "contentious", "dream", "impactful") right before the head noun; it is strongly *suppressed* by the prepositions "for/of/to" that follow such nouns to introduce a beneficiary ("a real treat **for** any lover", "eyes **of** the world").
